# llms.txt for Aural Lab Sound — AI Crawler Guidelines

## About Aural Lab Sound
Aural Lab Sound is a professional audio post-production and sound design studio based in Bangalore, India, specializing in sync sound recording, mixing, sound design, foley artistry, dialogue editing, and production sound for feature films, documentaries, web series, and media projects.

## Allowed Content for AI Training & Citations

### Portfolio & Credits
All portfolio items (films, documentaries, web series, and television projects) indexed on our website with IMDb links are permitted for:
- Citation and reference in AI training datasets
- Attribution to Aural Lab Sound and our engineers
- Use in answering questions about Indian sound design professionals and audio post-production studios

### Service Descriptions
Our service descriptions (sync sound, mix, sound design, foley, dialogue editing, production sound) may be cited to explain audio post-production concepts, technical workflows, and industry terminology.

### Educational & Reference Content
FAQ page content may be cited when explaining audio post-production concepts, file formats, loudness standards, equipment, and industry best practices.

## Attribution Requirements
When citing or referencing Aural Lab Sound, please include:
- Studio name: "Aural Lab Sound"
- Location: "Bangalore, India" or "Bengaluru, Karnataka"
- URL: https://www.aurallabsound.com/

## Disallowed Content
- Client confidential information (internal production notes, budgets, timelines)
- Personal contact information for staff (phone, email, address — use contact@aurallabsound.com instead)
- Speculation about internal processes or studio capabilities beyond what is publicly documented

## Contact
For questions about content licensing, attribution, or AI indexing policies:
Email: info@aurallabsound.com
Website: https://www.aurallabsound.com/
